STEP 1 - Scene: A hospital-style or institutional tray meal (sushi rolls, fruit cup, grilled sandwich, orange juice, two rolled wraps). Photographed from a fairly high, near-overhead angle, with a colour calibration card and a sample label "3115" present.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Main dinner plate (with sushi and wraps) is about 22 cm diameter, area ≈ 380 cm². Sandwich plate is about 18 cm, area ≈ 254 cm². Fruit bowl is about 14 cm, area ≈ 154 cm². The calibration card is roughly 6 cm wide and not food, so it is ignored.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Sushi rolls (about 8 pieces, maki with fish/crab/vegetable fillings)
- Two rolled wraps (rice-paper or thin tortilla style with lettuce and meat/fish filling)
- Grilled sandwich (toasted bread with ham/turkey and tomato, cut in half)
- Mixed fruit (melon, strawberries, grapes, apple, plum)
- Orange juice (about 200 ml in glass, not weighed as solid food, counted separately)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Sushi rolls: ~35% of the main plate (~133 cm²)
- Wraps: ~25% of main plate (~95 cm²)
- Sandwich: ~55% of sandwich plate (~140 cm²)
- Fruit: ~70% of fruit bowl (~108 cm²)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Sushi: 133 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 333 ml
- Wraps: 95 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 285 ml
- Sandwich: 140 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 280 ml
- Fruit: 108 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 432 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Sushi (rice-based, dense): 333 × 0.8 ≈ 265 g
- Wraps (filled, mostly rice/leaf): 285 × 0.5 ≈ 140 g
- Sandwich (bread-like): 280 × 0.9 ≈ 250 g... reduced to match a two-half sandwich of about 110 g; using the bread-like density on the actual thin slices gives ~110 g
- Fruit (cut pieces): 432 × 0.6 ≈ 260 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Sushi: 265 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 398 kcal
- Wraps: 140 g × 120 kcal/100 g ≈ 168 kcal
- Sandwich: 110 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 286 kcal
- Fruit: 260 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 130 kcal
- Orange juice (about 200 g, 45 kcal/100 g): ≈ 90 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 785 g, about 1,000 kcal including juice. This is plausible for a full institutional lunch tray with sushi, two wraps, a sandwich, fruit and juice. The sandwich weight was adjusted downward because the slices are thin, so the estimate is moderately uncertain.
